einzeiler: Discussion on Fed rate hikes, the oil crisis, and Paramount's California exit.
kurzfassung: Patrick Bet-David and the team discuss the Federal Reserve raising interest rates amidst surging inflation and fuel prices. They also break down Saudi Arabia’s escalating fight with the Houthis, the growing global oil crisis, Paramount threatening to leave California, the battle over AI, Lindsay Clancy’s holdout juror, and much more.
